article.headline: Spending denoising steps where a video patch needs them
article.lead: ForcingBooster changes the compute budget across patches of the same video. Gen4P uses a pretrained video generator for a different job, recovering geometry and motion without iterative denoising. Their speed claims refer to different outputs.

paragraphs.text: Gen4P introduces a framework that transforms pretrained video generators into a feed-forward 4D perceiver. This method allows for the recovery of 4D geometry and motion from monocular video efficiently, utilizing on-demand querying and continuous-time queries. It incorporates a frozen geometry prior via a pretrained video-depth LoRA, which enhances performance on tasks like 3D point tracking, video depth, and camera pose estimation. Gen4P achieves state-of-the-art results, demonstrating the effectiveness of leveraging video generative pretraining for unified 4D perception.

The paper introduces T2-Z, a novel approach for test-time optimization of environment latents in robotic world models, achieving a reduction in object prediction error from 15.20 to 7.00 and increasing action success rates from 33.73% to 72.96% across various tasks.

Perceive, Predict, and Plan — The paper introduces P$^{3}$-WAM, a unified world action model that enhances egocentric dexterous manipulation by integrating 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning.
GeoState introduces a view-decoupled geometry representation for 3D world modeling, effectively separating scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observations.

Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training? — The paper introduces OneWM, a unified causal training framework that enhances both world and action modeling by treating actions as conditions for world prediction and targets for policy learning within a shared architecture.
SimForcing introduces a novel simulation-guided framework for robot world models that distills motion priors from simulation to enhance real-domain video generation.

SUPRA-TEX introduces a novel approach to single image 3D generation by decoupling visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion, which enhances fidelity and detail preservation.

The paper introduces 3DCodeVerse, a comprehensive ecosystem for coding agents to generate and verify 3D content, featuring a large-scale dataset of 2 million executable 3D code snippets and a multi-agent framework for automated content refinement.

Not Just a Subject — The paper introduces EOS-Story, a training-free framework that enhances visual storytelling by harmonizing identity consistency with scene-specific adaptation in text-to-image generation.

Beyond Pairwise Repulsion — The paper introduces Determinant Noise Optimization (DetNO), a novel approach for enhancing diversity in text-to-image diffusion models by maximizing the log-determinant of an RBF Gram matrix over initial noise vectors.

The paper introduces ForcingBooster, a novel framework for adaptive patch-wise denoising in autoregressive video diffusion models, which dynamically allocates denoising steps based on the complexity of individual video patches.

The CoWorld Reasoner introduces a novel framework for agentic multimodal reasoning that leverages a Video World Model (VWM) as a unified visual reasoning engine, allowing for flexible visual imagination across diverse tasks.

H-DDCM introduces a scalable generative compression framework that replaces dense Gaussian codebooks with implicit randomized Hadamard dictionaries, achieving O(d log d) compute for projection and reconstruction and O(d) memory usage.
The PAIR framework introduces a novel approach to bridging perception and action in vision-language-action (VLA) models by learning a shared perception-action representation.

VLA-Δ introduces a novel framework for vision-language-action models that explicitly supervises physical state transitions, addressing the limitations of existing methods that rely solely on observation-action correspondences.
When the KV Cache Is Slower Than the GPU — The paper presents a novel approach to optimizing the use of remote key-value (KV) caches in long-context LLM serving, specifically for the GLM-5.3 model.
lightseekorg/tokenspeed — TokenSpeed is an inference engine designed for large language models (LLMs) that optimizes performance to achieve near real-time processing speeds.
